title: discover and diff
objective: `discover` and `diff`. Discovery turns an observed world into a desk: standard windows only, full-screen ones as `fullscreen`, frames snapped to the desk's grid with the misfit recorded, every display with its four match fields, the Dock bindings read. `--save <desk>` writes into the catalogue and refuses to overwrite without `--force`. `diff <desk>` is the planner's output rendered as what apply would do, exit 1 when anything differs. Both are tested from fixture worlds through the fake `hs`, and a discovered desk round-trips through the validator unchanged.
